entry_definition: One-dimensional diffusion-reaction model of ALD growth in a lateral channel with reversible Langmuir adsorption; the reactant pressure uses a closed-form approximation and the surface coverage (Eq. 31) is solved numerically (4th-order Runge-Kutta; ODE23 in Yim 2020) (Ylilammi 2018, Secs. III-V; listed as analytical in Cremers 2019, Sec. V A 1).

lookup: model: symbol 'Model B' of this paper
entry_definition: Diffusion–reaction model of ALD in a high-aspect-ratio feature by Yanguas-Gil and Elam (yim22 ref. 20): irreversible single-site adsorption (no desorption term), reactant partial pressure from the diffusion equation solved numerically together with the surface-coverage equation (yim22: MATLAB pdepe, slab symmetry, free molecular flow D_eff = D_Kn); the model behind the Arts et al. slope method (arts_slope). Distinct from yanguas_gil_markov_chain (a Markov-chain model).
